findings.detail: GAV_BDC02 reported no comparison denominator even though the filing provides a March 31, 2026 investment fair value anchor of 1,495,157 thousand and total assets of 1,552,028 thousand.

rationale: The flag states the BDC GAV reconciliation has no comparison denominator. Raw source contradicts that: the schedule and fair-value hierarchy both disclose Total Investments fair value of 1,495,157 thousand for March 31, 2026, and the balance sheet separately discloses Total Assets of 1,552,028 thousand. The absence of a comparison denominator is therefore an anchor/extraction availability defect, not an undecidable source condition.
